set_boost_mode.name: Set boost mode
set_boost_mode.description: Activates or deactivates a full-boost mode on a climate entity. This uses the app's /boost_mode path; the boost temperature and duration numbers remain the defaults.

active.name: Active
active.description: Activate the mode (true) or deactivate the running mode (false).

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Boost mode to activate: temp_and_time, max_temp_fixed_time, advanced_slot, or runback. Required when active is true.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Target temperature in the node's own unit; omitted leaves the device value unchanged.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Requested duration in minutes; omitted leaves the device value unchanged.

set_boost_params.name: Set boost parameters
set_boost_params.description: Sets temperature and duration parameters for the boost function.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: The boost number entity (temperature or duration) to configure.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: The target temperature to set during boost mode, in the target entity's unit (5-30 °C or 41-86 °F).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: The duration of boost mode in minutes.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Sets (part of) the heater's own weekly schedule. Keys are the days "0".."6" (Monday..Sunday); each value is the list of hourly profile slots (0=frost, 1=eco, 2=comfort). Omitted days keep their current programme.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: Day-keyed profile slots, e.g. day "0": [0, 0, 1, 1, ...], with 24 entries per day (48 where the heater supports half-hourly slots).

ws_user_flapping.title: Smartbox websocket endpoint keeps disappearing
ws_user_flapping.description: The ws_user endpoint keeps rejecting or disappearing ({error}). The integration re-probes it in place with a capped backoff, so a backend that starts serving again is picked up without a reload. If the endpoint never comes back, the host may not serve ws_user (check the vendor app's Version menu); this version does not support socket_io-only hosts.

node_added.title: New Smartbox heaters detected
node_added.description: The Smartbox account reported new nodes: {nodes}. Reload the Smartbox integration to add their entities. Existing entities were left untouched, so a temporary backend glitch cannot remove them.
